gaps.item: Review gate supply: servable frames and transition families
gaps.source: spec/v2-upgrades/words.md W1 Content (supply minimums, review gate), W2 Content (pairs.json), §3.1 override 17 (build checks)
gaps.evidence: In the preview content, 797 of 5,376 frames are servable. 0 of 1,244 SAT senses have 6 or more servable frames (1,159 have at least 1). 0 of 153 transition families are servable. PYTHONPATH=. python3 tools/build_words.py (run in a scratch copy) exits 0 and only warns: 'frames: 348 SAT senses short of 6 frames over 2 subjects' and 'servable frame minimum waits for independent adjudications and S9 review gate'. The code turns these checks into warnings on purpose (tools/build_words.py:491-495).
gaps.build: Finish the two-adjudication pass so every SAT sense is a legal key in at least 6 reviewed frames over 2 or more subjects, and at least 150 transition families (15 or more per logic) are reviewed. Then make tools/build_words.py exit 1 on the override-17 supply checks instead of warning.

gaps.item: Transitions items (Pick the transition, relationship first, logic map Practise, transition card back)
gaps.source: words.md W2; §3.8.3 §7 Types 'Pick the transition'
gaps.evidence: POST /api/words/run {mode:'quiz', deck:{source:'collection', value:'transitions'}, formats:['transition']} returns 409 'no reviewed frame is available for this word'. On /words/?c=transitions, clicking a column's 'Practise · 8' only shows the toast 'No reviewed frame is available for this word'. The card item's back payload (api_words.py _make_item) has no logic group or example pairs.
gaps.build: Serve reviewed pairs.json families through words.item('rw.tr.*'). Put the logic group and two generated pairs on a transition's card back. The relationship-first step, the logic map and logic mix-up drills then work as coded.

gaps.item: Words check (12 SAT-form items in 14:12)
gaps.source: words.md W15
gaps.evidence: POST /api/words/run {mode:'check'} returns 409 'not enough reviewed items for a Words check'. In the browser, /words/study/?mode=quiz → Mode 'Words check' → Start only shows the toast 'Not enough reviewed items for a Words check'.
gaps.build: After transitions are servable, make the check draw 6 in-context items (1–2 of them nearly), 4 transitions and 2 most precise, with the two-stage step up. Until the supply exists, the Words check chip should say why it is unavailable instead of failing on Start.

gaps.item: Word of the day and Transition of the day, answerable
gaps.source: words.md W21; §3.1 override 19 (Today strip)
gaps.evidence: GET /api/words/today returns wic: null and transition: null for every learner. words.daily_item (server/words.py:1355) needs senses with 6 or more servable frames (there are 0) and servable families (there are 0). On /words/ at 1280 and 390, the strip shows only Due today and New today, and a new learner's strip is empty.
gaps.build: Once the supply exists, daily_item returns both items. Until then, fall back to senses with at least 1 servable frame for wic, so the two tiles (and Today's rw:wic and rw:transition slots) always have an item.

gaps.item: Twin: same word, new text (T) and the sheet sample's Twin
gaps.source: words.md W1 Screens (Same word, new text), acceptance 5 and 8; product.md G2 acceptance 5, R44
gaps.evidence: After answering an in-context item, POST /api/words/run/{id}/another {like:'word'} returned 409 'this twin was already added; request another' on both tries (like:'trap' worked). In the browser, pressing T on the verdict leaves the item unchanged and toasts 'This twin was already added; request another'. On the sheet, 6 calls of POST /api/words/sample {slug:'mitigate', like:'word'} all returned the same text ('Planting trees along city streets can ____ the summer heat…'). The cause is that choose_template falls back to a template already seen, and the duplicate guard in api_words.py:883 then rejects it.
gaps.build: In words.another, choose an unseen frame (supply as above). When none is left, use the same frame with a new seed and a different fill or key, and never return the item already in the run. If nothing new exists, return a clear 'no new text yet' and have the pages disable Twin.

gaps.item: Complete card back: SAME AS / OPPOSITE, NOT THE SAME AS, SHADES, BUILT FROM, partners
gaps.source: §3.1 override 31 (§6 Card back); words.md W17 'Every card back complete', W3 SHADES strip on card backs, W4 BUILT FROM on card backs
gaps.evidence: The card item back payload (api_words.py _make_item kind card/fix) has only meaning, short, examples, sentence, hook and picks. After flipping in the browser, the back shows only 'MEANING', 'IN A NEW SENTENCE', 'More examples' and 'Open word' (checked at 1280 and 390). TopTierPrep's back shows synonyms, antonyms and confusions.
gaps.build: Server: add same/opposite (resolved), up to 2 confusions with tells plus a +N count, shades, roots with split and gloss, and partners to the card back. Page (web/words/run/index.html backFace): render SAME AS / OPPOSITE chips, up to two NOT THE SAME AS rows then '+1 more' (opens the sheet), SHADES, BUILT FROM and partners.

gaps.item: Lists of library words (New list, Save as a list, word-list import)
gaps.source: §3.8.3 §3 Collections (MINE ends with New list), §9 Lists; words.md W19 Data (word_lists)
gaps.evidence: POST /api/words/lists {name:'Unit 3', words:[6 slugs]} returns 200 and word_lists holds the row. But no /api/words row has 'Unit 3' in lists, the mine group lists only 'My words', and the Library MINE group shows only 'My words' and 'English' (own words). So a list made with '+ New list', Bring words 'Save as a list' or the importer never appears as a tile, a Collection option or a deck.
gaps.build: words.library: merge word_lists membership into each row's lists and add each list to the mine group's collections (with count, known, due), so the Library tiles, the Collection filter, the study decks and Share all see it.

gaps.item: Today page Words tile
gaps.source: §3.1 override 42 (§11 Today); words.md W11 'Today's Words tile' and acceptance 6
gaps.evidence: On / for the seeded learner, the Words card reads '22 due · -16 new · ~5 min'. web/index.html:2493 computes new_goal - new_today with no floor, so it goes negative once the goal is exceeded. The card's only control is 'All words'. There is no Today's words pill and no Review cards / Learn 10 / Quiz, and no 'known · claimed' line.

gaps.item: R&W answers as the first rw bank (attempts, Review, drill)
gaps.source: product.md R57 and G11 'The first rw bank' (acceptance 2–3); row 44
gaps.evidence: GET /api/types?subject=rw returns []. POST /api/drill {subject:'rw', topics:['words-in-context'], count:5} returns 409 {reason:'no_bank'}. After 14 generated word_reviews for the seeded learner, attempts has 0 rows with template 'rw.%'. The columns attempts.word and word_reviews.attempt exist but are never written. words.rw_answers still reads word_reviews.

File every generated R&W answer (run, sheet sample, daily, drill) through progress.record into attempts with word set, and link word_reviews.attempt. Open a misconception trap on a miss (norm = trap id). Point words.rw_answers at attempts.

gaps.item: By exam day 'Auto' new-words chip
gaps.source: words.md W12 (New words a day chips … Auto)
gaps.evidence: On /words/mine/, clicking the chip labelled 'auto' sends PUT /api/me {"prefs":{"words_goal":null}}, toasts 'auto new words a day', and GET /api/me then shows words_goal 10. words-ui.js:455-462 relies on c.auto, but the server's chip is {goal:'auto', daily:16}, so it sends +'auto' (NaN). For the same reason the label reads lowercase 'auto' instead of 'Auto · 16'.
gaps.build: web/assets/words-ui.js wordsFinish: treat c.goal === 'auto' as the Auto chip, label it 'Auto · {daily}', send words_goal 'auto', and select it when the pref is 'auto'.

gaps.item: Near-synonym traps and Most precise
gaps.source: words.md W1 Generator (trap preference lookalike, too_strong/too_weak, connotation…), W3 Most precise (precise) and its ladder verdict, W5 trap deck
gaps.evidence: There are 0 servable frames that pin intensity. Across 300 served items (900 distractors) the trap kinds were reversed 641, topical 165, lookalike 72, connotation 22, and too_strong/too_weak 0. 130 of the 300 items had all three distractors 'reversed'. POST /api/words/run {deck:{source:'trap', value:'too_strong'}} returns 409, so 'Twin ×10' on a Too strong trap row fails. A 'precise' item is only an in-context item relabelled (api_words.py:94), and its verdict draws no ladder.
gaps.build: Review intensity-pinning frames so too strong and too weak neighbours are served. Build 'precise' from frames that pin one intensity, with two same-class neighbours and one reversed. On the verdict, draw the ladder with the key and the pick marked (run page).

gaps.item: In-context and print runs on a collection deck
gaps.source: §3.8.3 §5 (a type the deck cannot supply is disabled with its reason); words.md W1 Practise 10 in context, W20 worksheets
gaps.evidence: POST /api/words/run {mode:'quiz', deck:{source:'collection', value:'sat-core'}, formats:['incontext'], count:10} returns 409 'no reviewed frame is available for this word'. The same happens for {mode:'print', …, formats:['incontext']}. The whole run fails because one word in the deck lacks a frame. The pages hide this by silently falling back to the meaning types (study go(), printSheet).
gaps.build: When a run asks for incontext/nearly/transition/precise, pick deck words that have a servable frame, or give an unsupplied word a Meaning → word item. Return 409 only when no word can supply the format.

gaps.item: Run summary sections
gaps.source: §3.8.3 §8 Summary; §3.1 override 37; words.md W5, W6, W7 (calibration, guesses), W13 (graduation)
gaps.evidence: api_words.py _summary always returns "groups": [] and has no calibration, guesses, graduations, gaps or logic mix-ups. The run page summary (run/index.html summary()) renders none of these, and its mix-up rows are by trap kind only (no lookalike Quiz the pair).
gaps.build: Server: fill groups [{id, name, known_before, known_after, right, asked}], and add guesses {n, right}, calibration, graduations (seen → missed → in context ✓ dates), gaps {word, reading} and logic pairs. Page: per-collection rows whose known-bar animates from before to after, the calibration and guess lines, graduations, word vs reading gaps with Learn these / Practise finding the clue, and logic and lookalike rows with Quiz the pair.

gaps.item: Fix card for stubborn words
gaps.source: words.md W9 The Fix card (items 2–5)
gaps.evidence: For a word with 4 lapses and picks illusory ×2 and evasive ×1, the due run holds one item of kind 'fix' with picks and hook. Its back is the ordinary card back. It does not show the most-picked word's meaning with the tell side by side, BUILT FROM or SHADES, a My hook input, or the 3-item pair quiz: the run had 1 item, and 'All 3 right → box 2' is absent.
gaps.build: Server: add the rival word (most picked, else top lookalike) with both meanings and the tell, and append the 3-item pair quiz (the key alternating) after the Fix card, with the all-3-right rule. Page: render the side-by-side, BUILT FROM/SHADES and a hook field on the Fix card.

gaps.item: Today's words run composition and preview
gaps.source: words.md W11 The run (parts 1–7, spacing rules, Preview), W14 (starred 14 days), W5 (2 items for an open trap)
gaps.evidence: The seeded mix run's stored order was: due cards, learn, learn, then the incontext proofs, then checks and transition learn cards. There were no items for the learner's open trap, no in-context item for yesterday's word and no root card. words.deck('today') has no starred-14-days or lookalike-spacing rule. today_summary.preview hard-codes 'transitions': 3, and the › preview sheet lists parts without a switch per part.
gaps.build: words.deck('today'): put proofs before missed and learn items, add 2 open-trap items and 2–3 transition items, 1 in-context item for a word learned yesterday, 1 root card per 10 new, and starred words untouched for 14 days. Keep lookalike pairs 3 or more items apart. Compute the preview counts from the real parts, and add per-part switches in the preview sheet.
